title: Ceyo Sierra Leone | 24/7 Autonomous AI Agents
description: Run autonomous AI agents on dedicated cloud computers in Sierra Leone. Automate cross-border trade, research, coding, and operations 24/7 without downtime.
h1: Scale Your Freetown Business with Autonomous AI
sub: Deploy persistent AI agents that research, write code, and coordinate tasks across 1,000+ apps on private cloud computers—active around the clock, even when your phone disconnects.
audience: Import-export merchants, logistics operators at Queen Elizabeth II Quay, software developers in Freetown, NGO managers, and regional agribusiness exporters across Bo and Kenema.
manifesto: Connectivity drops and power outages should never pause your enterprise. Ceyo gives every Sierra Leonean entrepreneur a resilient cloud computer that trades, researches, and codes non-stop, turning ambitious local ideas into borderless international operations.

uses.d: Monitor shipments arriving at Queen Elizabeth II Quay and automatically organize customs paperwork and manifest updates inside Google Sheets.
Track global cocoa, coffee, and palm oil market fluctuations across overseas commodity boards to negotiate stronger export contracts.
Direct cloud coding agents to build, test, and host client websites and digital services without relying on high-end local workstations.
Autonomously browse international supplier catalogues, evaluate shipping quotes, and gather verified supplier contacts for retail inventory.
Scan global industrial markets for replacement parts, mining supplies, and solar hardware specifications suited for operations upcountry.
Consolidate field survey inputs from multiple districts into polished donor summaries, weekly KPI tables, and structured Notion databases.

steps.d: Select an agent template or build a custom specialist equipped with its own dedicated cloud computer.
Link your bot to Telegram and integrate critical apps like Gmail, Google Sheets, CRMs, and calendars.
Instruct your agents through natural prompts and schedule recurring autonomous workflows around the clock.

chapters.d: While traffic crawls through Congo Cross, your autonomous browser reviews international logistics indices and port status updates. A structured summary arrives directly in your Telegram group before your first morning meeting.

Your agent coordinates with your operations team in a shared Telegram channel, compiling customer orders and cross-checking records. It flags discrepancy rows directly inside your cloud inventory spreadsheet.

Your coding agent works in its sandboxed environment, fixing bugs in your client portal and testing database connections. It presents a functioning deployment link without using any battery on your mobile phone.

As Freetown sleeps and local power cuts take hold, your cloud computers remain fully operational. Bots run overnight web scrapers, analyze market documents, and prepare your morning schedules uninterrupted.

faq.q: What are the pricing plans and is there a free trial?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three subscription tiers: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every plan begins with a 3-day free trial providing up to 1,000,000 tokens per day; a payment card is linked upon signup and is only charged once the trial concludes if you choose not to cancel.

faq.q: Will my agents keep working during local power cuts or internet outages?
faq.a: Yes. Each Ceyo bot operates inside its own isolated cloud computer hosted in secure data centres, meaning all routines, browsing tasks, and code executions continue running 24/7 even if your mobile phone or home internet goes offline.

faq.q: Can I manage my agents directly through Telegram?
faq.a: Yes. You can assign tasks to individual Telegram bots or create group chats where multiple specialist bots collaborate with you and your team in real time.

faq.q: Which languages can Ceyo agents understand and write?
faq.a: Ceyo works fluently in English and handles dozens of international languages, adapting easily to local phrasing, business terminology, and formal documentation styles.

faq.q: How does Ceyo connect with my existing business apps?
faq.a: Ceyo integrates seamlessly with over 1,000 popular services including Gmail, Google Sheets, Slack, Notion, calendars, and leading CRM platforms, letting agents update records and send alerts automatically.
